**Finding re-submitted: Compliant** (no redline, no comment — correct output for a compliant clause).

What I repaired: the earlier quote evidenced the performance warranty but not its duration, which is what the deterministic period check flagged. The quote is now the Section 9(b)(ix) "now and throughout the Term" language, so the record itself shows why no fixed 90-day/12-month figure appears.

Substance is unchanged and confirmed:

- **Warranty scope** — industry-standard performance (p0034), freedom from errors materially affecting utility (p0038), no malicious code (p0036), ongoing compliance with Law (p0041).
- **Duration** — continuing across the Term (one-year Initial Term, auto-renewing) rather than a fixed post-delivery window. Longer and better than the preferred 12-month/90-day parameter; the regex miss is a drafting-form artifact, and inserting a fixed period would *shorten* our protection.
- **Disclaimer** — Section 13 is double-carved, so it bites only on implied warranties and the no-minimum-revenue acknowledgement. Express warranty survives; not walk-away territory.
- **Remedy** — no express repair/re-perform/refund sentence, noted as a sub-element only. With no exclusive-remedy clause and no liability cap, we keep full direct damages, warranty-breach indemnity (p0051) and the 30-day cure/termination right (p0016). An exclusive remedy would narrow us, so it stays unflagged.
